experience.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
canonical_bullets: Built a data pipeline that cleaned and merged 5 heterogeneous lab datasets into one training-ready corpus.
Trained a baseline classification model and improved its validation F1 score from 0.71 to 0.84 through feature engineering.
Wrote automated tests that reduced a recurring data-pipeline regression from happening roughly weekly to zero over 3 months.
Presented findings in a lab-wide seminar and incorporated feedback into a revised experiment design.

experience.title: AI Engineer Intern
alternate_bullets_for_dynamic_tailoring: Built an internal tool that automated a manual data-labeling step, cutting labeling turnaround time from 2 days to 4 hours.
Integrated a vector database into an internal search prototype and added evaluation scripts the team still uses.

projects.name: Project Atlas
canonical_bullets: Designed a document-classification pipeline covering 6 document categories with a held-out accuracy of 91%, combining hybrid dense+sparse retrieval (BM25 + embeddings with RRF fusion) for candidate-passage ranking before classification.
Built a labeling and evaluation harness that cut manual QA time by half compared to the initial spreadsheet-based process; served via a FastAPI microservice with Redis caching.
Wrote unit and integration tests achieving 85% coverage of the pipeline's core modules.

projects.name: Project Beacon
canonical_bullets: Implemented a recommendation prototype using collaborative filtering over a public 100k-rating dataset, then re-ranked candidates with RRF for a small offline NDCG@10 lift.
Improved offline NDCG@10 from 0.41 to 0.53 through hyperparameter tuning and feature engineering.
Packaged the prototype as a reproducible CLI with a documented evaluation harness, exposed through a FastAPI service with Redis-backed result caching.
